cycle_report.summary: Successfully integrated af_engine (the canonical modular engine package) directly with dashboard_v2.py. The dashboard previously accessed all engine state via indirect file reads through io_utils.atomic_read_json(). This cycle replaced that pattern with direct af_engine API calls, added a new /api/engine/status endpoint, enriched /api/recovery/check with SnapshotManager data, added a startup health check, and validated everything with 59 passing integration tests. A bug was also found and fixed in the recovery endpoint where the incomplete_missions branch was missing snapshot_data.
achievements: Audited dashboard_v2.py and identified all indirect engine state access patterns (exclusively via io_utils.atomic_read_json on raw JSON files, zero af_engine imports prior to this mission)

Added /api/engine/status endpoint to dashboard_modules/core.py returning 9-field JSON (available, version, mission_id, stage, iteration, cycle, cycle_budget, stages, latency_ms) sourced directly from af_engine.StateManager
Enhanced /api/health to include af_engine in the services dict, making health checks reflect actual engine availability
Enhanced /api/recovery/check to include snapshot_data from SnapshotManager in all three response branches (recovery_needed, incomplete_missions, clean_state)
Added non-blocking af_engine health check to dashboard_v2.py startup sequence that logs engine stage and version without blocking startup on failure
Built 557-line integration test suite (test_dashboard_engine_integration.py) with 5 test classes covering engine status, health, recovery, cross-validation, and direct API tests
All 59 tests pass (42 pytest unit/integration + 17 adversarial/concurrent/load tests)
Found and fixed bug: incomplete_missions branch in /api/recovery/check was missing snapshot_data field
Performance validated: /api/engine/status ~28ms typical, well within 2000ms threshold
issues: Mission statement referenced 'modular_engine' but the canonical package is 'af_engine' — correctly identified and targeted af_engine throughout
Bug found during testing: /api/recovery/check incomplete_missions branch was missing snapshot_data — fixed during the BUILDING stage
